description: We manufacture an insulated metal panel with factory-sealed joints. It's a face-sealed system: no drainage cavity behind it. We'd like to sell it for houses across Alberta, including places that get a lot of rain and snowmelt. Some inspectors say they need a gap behind the cladding. Can we get a general acceptance?

missing_info.field: target-location heating degree-days and moisture index
missing_info.why: Climate determines whether the capillary-break benchmark applies.

missing_info.field: building and backing materials, accessory-building status, and assembly performance basis
missing_info.why: The sentence contains acceptable-solution exceptions; no drained cavity alone does not settle the route.

missing_info.field: test or field evidence that omitting the capillary break does not harm the assembly

should_cite.why: Candidate benchmark only; deciding facts must be obtained first.
conditions under which the capillary break may be omitted
what counts as a capillary break

gold.engineering_reason: Product request without a building; professional involvement depends on the buildings it is used on.

identify_gold_candidates.label: model-checked, not human-verified
identify_gold_candidates.quote: exterior walls exposed to precipitation shall be protected against precipitation ingress by an exterior cladding assembly consisting of a first plane of protection and a second plane of protection incorporating a capillary break
identify_gold_candidates.reasoning: Face-sealed panel with no drained cavity = no capillary break; the requirement applies only in locations meeting the degree-day / moisture-index conditions, which 'places that get a lot of rain and snowmelt' implies but does not establish.

identify_gold_candidates.label: model-checked, not human-verified
identify_gold_candidates.quote: the first and second planes of protection need not incorporate a capillary break, where a) it can be shown that omitting the capillary break will not adversely affect the performance of the building assemblies
identify_gold_candidates.reasoning: The exception the manufacturer's evidence would target. Not the varied provision.
